links.why: The Starting lesson extends the Stage 5 index laws for positive and zero powers.
links.basis: Advanced lesson f-algebra-fluency (outcome MAV-11-01): its Starting level covers positive integer and zero powers, the laws K–10 na-index-laws teaches.

links.why: The Developing lesson extends the Stage 5 rules for negative indices.
links.basis: Advanced lesson f-algebra-fluency (outcome MAV-11-01): its Developing level covers negative integer indices, which K–10 na-negative-indices-algebraic teaches.

links.why: Right-triangle modelling in Year 11 starts from the sine, cosine and tangent ratios.
links.basis: Advanced lesson t-ratios-review (outcome MAV-11-04), right-triangle modelling; K–10 ms-trig-ratios (Stage 5 core).

links.why: Year 11 extends changing the subject to formulas with a squared term.
links.basis: Standard lesson ms11-rearrange-formulas (outcome MST-11-01), scope "For y=ax²+c isolate the square"; K–10 na-change-subject (Stage 5).

links.why: Year 11 adds metric prefixes and significant figures to Stage 5 scientific notation.
links.basis: Standard lesson ms11-scientific-notation (outcome MST-11-05); K–10 ms-scientific-notation (Stage 5).

links.why: Year 11 exponential graphs build on the exponential curves graphed in Stage 5.
links.basis: Concept names in both trees: "Exponential graphs and end behaviour" (Advanced, Year 11) and "Graphs exponential curves of the form y = a^x" (K–10, Stage 5).

links.why: Break-even models solve two linear equations simultaneously, a Stage 5 method.
links.basis: Concept names in both trees: "Linear models, simultaneous equations and break-even" (Advanced, Year 11) and "Solves simultaneous linear equations graphically and algebraically" (K–10, Stage 5).

links.why: The Strong lesson teaches fractional powers again; Stage 5 met them first.
links.basis: The Advanced lesson states that no fractional indices are assumed, so this is not marked Builds on. Review 3 §4.3.

links.why: Year 11 sets use the set language and notation from Stage 5.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3. K–10 sp-set-notation is Path content: confirm which Stage 5 paths Mathematics Advanced assumes.

links.why: Year 11 Venn diagrams extend Stage 5 Venn diagrams and two-way tables.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3. K–10 sp-venn-two-way is Path content.

links.why: The exact ratios for 30, 45 and 60 degrees come from Stage 5.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3. K–10 ms-exact-trig-ratios is Path content.

links.why: Year 11 logarithms start from the Stage 5 definition of a logarithm.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3. K–10 na-logarithm-definition is Path content.

links.why: The Year 11 logarithm laws extend the laws deduced in Stage 5.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3. K–10 na-log-laws is Path content.

links.why: Year 12 logarithmic scales extend the Stage 5 work on logarithmic scales.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3. K–10 na-logarithmic-scales is Path content.

links.why: Year 11 exponential graphs use the Stage 5 transformations of exponential curves.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3.

links.why: Linear models read the gradient and the intercept from y = mx + c.
links.basis: Review 3 §4.3.
